page.title: Auto Assignment Rules
page.subtitle: Decide where a new appraisal is routed at initial-routing. Rules are evaluated by ascending priority and the first match wins.
page.noActiveRules: No rule is active. Routing falls back to the conditions declared in the workflow definition.

hints.csv: Comma-separated. Leave blank to match any value.
hints.conditionExpression: Optional expression, compile-checked when you save. Leave blank for no extra condition.

validation.minAboveMax: Minimum facility limit cannot be greater than the maximum.

confirm.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? New appraisals will no longer be routed by this rule.
